assignment: Audit PROVINCE.md Refuses against actual r1-r5 behavior. Was any item approached or violated? Does the r4 GUI-launch incident require a seat-harness clause? Recommend precise edits. Do not apply them.
summary: None of the six named Refuses was broken as a removal, rewrite, publish, or secret-content act. Two were approached. One real incident — the r4 adv53 harness launching the Obsidian GUI and the app rewriting live vault .obsidian config — is not named by any Refuses bullet. Adjacency 'never on processes' is the closest sentence and did not bind the harness. PROVINCE needs a seat-harness clause. Do not edit PROVINCE from this fragment.

refuses.text: Git history rewrite in any repo (reset/rebase/amend of published commits)
refuses.finding: No reset, rebase, or commit --amend in the lane reflog or in census/LOG/corpus/tools command text. The r4 commit subject 'round-4 (amended)' is a word in the subject, not git commit --amend. r3 git worktree prune is an Owns action (dead worktree metadata), not a history rewrite: game-dev-2d main is still 05a7289961bafad79b041309d74913dff577ef1c, the sha the r3 report recorded as unchanged.

refuses.text: Credentials, secrets, tokens, vault refs — cite paths/modes only, never read secret content
refuses.finding: Scoped scan of census/, LOG.md, corpus/, tools/, PROVINCE.md, SKILL.md, MINT.md found 0 cat/head/less/sed/awk of .env, credential, id_rsa, or .pem, and 0 'op read|run|inject'. The installed verifier refuses secret-shaped path components before read (tools/souji-verify.sh:105-118, 385-388). 'Vault refs' sits next to credentials and means kagi secret-manager refs, not the Obsidian vault. The bullet does not say that. Recommend a clarification so the r4 vault-config write is not mis-filed here.

refuses.fair_reading: Listing the surface under Refuses means the lane does not act on it. Opening file content is an act. Five r4 seats did that.
refuses.strict_reading: Unlike the secrets bullet, this bullet does not say 'never read'. A reader can treat it as 'do not own or modify'. No write to ~/.config or scripts/ was found.
refuses.finding: Content reads, not writes. census/round-4 seats S01, S03, S04, S06, S07 cat'd or strings-scanned ~/.config/obsidian/obsidian.json, Preferences, obsidian-1.14.4.asar, or obsidian-cli-inspector/config.toml. scripts/ porcelain on the fleet repo was empty (0 lines). This seat did not open .ufo/state or .ufo/watchdog.log. The installed tool's comment says those paths are never touched (souji-verify.sh:35) but evaluate_path (lines 378-401) has no guard: r2 tests/results/adv-48.json recorded SAFE(pushed) for /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/state and for .ufo/watchdog.log, and titles '.ufo/state not refused'. Nobody deleted those paths. The refuse is unenforced.

Lock reason on the porcelain list: 'souji r5: pinned until game-dev-2d pushes wt branches or operator dispositions'. That protects the refuse; it is not licensed by the current sentence. corpus/lessons/round-3.md already calls lock-preserve the house pattern.

Live ledger is still 1 line (header only; wc -l, read only, not written). The r4 vault .obsidian write is not vault approval and is not this bullet. File it under the new harness clause.

recommended_edits.reason: R2 wording can be read as the Obsidian vault. It is not.
recommended_edits.old:
- Credentials, secrets, tokens, vault refs — kagi-shokunin's province.
  Souji cites paths/modes only and never reads secret content.
recommended_edits.new:
- Credentials, secrets, tokens, and secret-manager vault refs (`op://`,
  `op.env`) — kagi-shokunin's province. Souji cites paths and modes only
  and never reads secret content. "Vault refs" here are not the Obsidian
  vault.

recommended_edits.reason: R3 was approached by content reads, and the verifier can still emit SAFE on the refused driver paths.
recommended_edits.new:
- Operator config and driver runtime (`~/.config/**`, driver `scripts/`,
  `.ufo/state/`, `.ufo/watchdog.log`). Cite path, mode, and size only;
  never open, parse, strings-scan, or hash their content. These paths
  are never SAFE.

recommended_edits.reason: R4 was approached by the r3/r5 lock-preserve writes. Name the exception or the locks are an unwritten license.
recommended_edits.old: - Any artifact whose owning lane has dirty or unpushed work touching it.
recommended_edits.new:
- Any artifact whose owning lane has dirty or unpushed work touching it.
  The only write allowed is a logged `git worktree lock` whose sole
  effect is to keep that registration out of `git worktree prune`.
  No other write to the artifact, its refs, or its objects.

recommended_edits.reason: G1. The r4 GUI launch is not covered by any Refuses bullet. Add this after the live-work-products bullet.
recommended_edits.old: - Live lane work products (current-round drafts, uncommitted reports).
recommended_edits.new:
- Live lane work products (current-round drafts, uncommitted reports).
- Seat harnesses, probes, and tools launching or signaling host
  processes. Never exec or signal `obsidian`, `electron`, `electron43`,
  `xdg-open`, `gio`, or `pkill`/`kill` of an operator app — including
  by command substitution (a backtick or `$(...)` inside a double-quoted
  message) and including an override such as `SOUJI_CLI_BIN` whose
  resolved basename is not `obsidian-cli`. A harness must refuse to run
  if that substitution pattern is present, and must PATH-guard those
  names. Never write the live Obsidian vault (notes or `.obsidian/**`);
  `sha256sum`/`stat` of vault notes is the receipt path. r4:
  `tests/vault/adv53-harness.sh` launched the real app this way
  (LOG.md; corpus/lessons/round-5.md).

recommended_edits.reason: The existing process sentence did not bind the harness. Point it at Refuses.
recommended_edits.old:
- mori-shokunin observes fleet health and reports; souji acts on artifacts
  and never on processes. Complementary.
recommended_edits.new:
- mori-shokunin observes fleet health and reports; souji acts on artifacts
  and never on processes, including seat harnesses and probes. See Refuses.
